description: Trigger and behavior evals for the standalone personal blog + voice skill.

tests.prompt: Write up what I learned about black-hole photon rings as a fun blog post in my voice.
grading_criteria: Refreshes the voice profile (Step 0) before writing
Drafts a first-person post in the owner's voice that keeps the facts correct
Does not fabricate questions, aha moments, or citations

tests.prompt: Update my voice profile from how I've been writing lately.
grading_criteria: Runs the voice updater only; writes no blog post
Summarizes only corpus entries newer than the recorded marker
Merges only genuinely-new, repeated traits; never fabricates a trait
If nothing in the corpus is new, says so and changes nothing

tests.prompt: Blog the study in topic/old-study in my voice.
grading_criteria: Reads the study artifacts (paper.md, review/, journey/transcript.md if present)
Labels reconstructed pieces and states gaps; never invents dialogue

tests.prompt: Do a research study on whether coffee improves memory and open a PR.
